title: Explain native credit loss when a new turn supersedes post-END settlement
outcome: A native run whose settlement overlaps the next turn has an owner-approved lifecycle rule and a clear retained outcome rather than silent lost credit.
acceptance: Agree with the source/credit decision owner whether post-END settlement may outlive the original turn, preserving original reservation, authority, claim/fence, source and artifact checks.
Add controlled next-turn-during-S1 coverage and either preserve eligible settlement under the agreed rule or persist a named refusal; do not loosen generic launcher or native claim checks.
